HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Review and modify security measures as needed to continue providing reasonable and appropriate protection of ePHI, and update related documentation.
Notes: Used mainly for maintenance / update best-fit mappings.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of ePHI.
Notes: Official title also appears in Appendix A Security Standards Matrix.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce identified risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level.
Notes: Used where evidence shows mitigation / remediation or maintenance of safeguards.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement procedures for terminating a workforce member’s access to ePHI when employment ends or when access should otherwise be removed.
Notes: Used for termination / transfer / access-revocation evidence.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to ePHI that are consistent with the applicable requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Rule.
Notes: Used at the standard level when the control is broader than a single access-management implementation specification.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement policies and procedures for granting access to ePHI through appropriate mechanisms such as workstations, transactions, programs, or processes.
Notes: Used when the evidence focuses on granting or approving access.

HIPAA_Requirement_Title: Information Access Management — Access Establishment and Modification
HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement policies and procedures to establish, document, review, and modify a user’s right of access to a workstation, transaction, program, or process.
Notes: Used when the evidence focuses on access reviews, modifications, or removals.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement a security awareness and training program for all members of the workforce, including management.
Notes: Used for broad workforce training controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Title: Security Awareness and Training — Protection from Malicious Software
HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.
Notes: Used for anti-malware and malicious-software protection controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Title: Security Awareness and Training — Password Management
HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.
Notes: Used for password-management policy and practice controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.
Notes: Used for broad incident-handling policy controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Title: Security Incident Procedures — Response and Reporting
HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents, mitigate harmful effects to the extent practicable, and document incidents and outcomes.
Notes: Used for incident response / reporting / postmortem evidence.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of ePHI.
Notes: Used for backup procedures and exact-copy evidence.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Establish and implement procedures to restore any loss of data.
Notes: Used for backup restoration and disaster-recovery evidence.

HIPAA_Requirement_Title: Contingency Plan — Applications and Data Criticality Analysis
HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data in support of contingency planning.
Notes: Used when the evidence distinguishes critical systems or data for backup / recovery planning.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Perform periodic technical and nontechnical evaluations, and repeat them in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of ePHI.
Notes: Used for evaluation, review, and testing best-fit mappings.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of ePHI and the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.
Notes: Used for disposal and secure destruction evidence.

HIPAA_Requirement_Title: Device and Media Controls — Media Re-use
HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement procedures for removing ePHI from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.
Notes: Used for media sanitization and re-use controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and the person responsible for them.
Notes: Used for custody / chain-of-responsibility evidence.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain ePHI to allow access only to persons or software programs with authorized access rights.
Notes: Used for broad technical access-control controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.
Notes: Used for named-account and unique-ID controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI.
Notes: Used for encryption at rest and decryption capability controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to ePHI is the one claimed.
Notes: Used for MFA / authentication controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement a mechanism to encrypt ePHI whenever deemed appropriate during electronic transmission.
Notes: Used for TLS and encryption-in-transit controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the Security Rule standards, implementation specifications, and other requirements.
Notes: Used for broad policy / procedure repository controls.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Maintain written or electronic policies and procedures implemented to comply with the Security Rule and written or electronic records of required actions, activities, and assessments.
Notes: Used for documentation-focused evidence and repositories.

HIPAA_Requirement_Summary: Review documentation periodically and update it as needed in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of ePHI.
Notes: Used when evidence focuses on keeping documentation current.
